title: Binance Adds Five More bStocks as Margin Collateral
why_it_matters: The expansion adds equity-linked collateral choices for eligible users but keeps the instruments inside restricted, leveraged exchange workflows rather than broad securities ownership.
caption:
RWA WIRE // COLLATERAL

Binance Adds Five More bStocks as Margin Collateral

Five equity-linked certificates entered Binance margin collateral workflows on October 28, while borrowing remains unsupported and access stays restricted.
